title: Fix failures after docker update
body:
* `calc.set()` is no longer allowed in recent GPAW.  Update test accordingly.
 * More lenient import count in the import count test.  Importing ase shouldn't cause many actual modules to be imported (unless we actually *do* something), but it nevertheless somehow ends up importing 261 modules.  We should fix this in a separate MR.
